description.zh: 漏洞名称。
description.en: The name of the vulnerability.

description.zh:
漏洞所在资产类型。多个类型使用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：
- **ECS**：主机资产
- **CONTAINER**：容器资产
description.en:
The asset type where the vulnerability is detected. Separate multiple types with commas (,). Valid values:
- **ECS**: host asset
- **CONTAINER**: container asset

description.zh:
查询应用漏洞时的附加漏洞类型。查询应用漏洞（即Type设置为app）时需要设置该参数。该参数固定取值为**sca**。

> 如果该参数设置为**sca**，可查询应用漏洞（**app**类型）及软件成分分析（**sca**类型）漏洞，如果不设置该参数，只查询应用漏洞。
description.en:
The additional vulnerability type when querying application vulnerabilities. This parameter is required when Type is set to app. The value is fixed as **sca**.

> If this parameter is set to **sca**, both application vulnerabilities (**app** type) and software composition analysis (**sca** type) vulnerabilities are queried. If this parameter is not set, only application vulnerabilities are queried.

description.zh: 要查询漏洞影响的容器名称。
description.en: The name of the container affected by the vulnerability.

description.zh:
首次扫描时间结束时间。
> 时间戳，单位为毫秒。
description.en:
The end of the time range during which the first scan was performed.
> The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh:
首次扫描时间起始时间。
> 时间戳，单位为毫秒。
description.en:
The start of the time range during which the first scan was performed.
> The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh: CVE编号。
description.en: The CVE ID.

description.zh:
要查询的漏洞是否已修复。取值：

- **y**：已修复
- **n**：未修复
description.en:
Specifies whether the vulnerability is fixed. Valid values:

- **y**: fixed
- **n**: not fixed

description.zh:
要查询的漏洞所在服务器的资产分组ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeAllGroups](~~DescribeAllGroups~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the asset group to which the server with the vulnerability belongs.
> Call the [DescribeAllGroups](~~DescribeAllGroups~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh: 要查询漏洞影响的镜像名称。
description.en: The name of the image affected by the vulnerability.

description.zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：

- zh：中文
- en：英文
description.en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese
- en: English

description.zh:
要查询的漏洞修复优先级。多个优先级使用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值包括：

- **asap**：高
- **later**：中
- **nntf**：低
description.en:
The priority of the vulnerability to query. Separate multiple priorities with commas (,). Valid values:

- **asap**: high
- **later**: medium
- **nntf**: low

description.zh: 要查询漏洞影响的进程路径。
description.en: The path of the process affected by the vulnerability.

description.zh:
应用防护（RASP）是否支持实时防护该漏洞。取值：

- **0**：不支持
- **1**：支持
description.en:
Specifies whether runtime application self-protection (RASP) supports real-time protection against the vulnerability. Valid values:

- **0**: Not supported.
- **1**: Supported.

description.zh: 资源目录账户ID
description.en: The ID of the resource directory account.

description.zh:
按照标签过滤。取值：

<props="china">
- 需要重启
- 远程利用
- 存在EXP
- 可被利用
- 本地提权
- 代码执行
</props>

<props="intl">
- **Restart required**
- **Remote utilization**
- **EXP exists**
- **Available**
- **Elevation of Privilege**
- **Code Execution**

</props>
description.en:
Filters results by label. Valid values:

<props="china">
- Restart required
- Remote utilization
- EXP exists
- Exploitable
- Privilege escalation
- Code execution
</props>

<props="intl">
- **Restart required**
- **Remote utilization**
- **EXP exists**
- **Available**
- **Elevation of Privilege**
- **Code Execution**

</props>

description.zh:
要导出的漏洞列表的漏洞类型。取值：

- **cve**：Linux软件漏洞
- **sys**：Windows系统漏洞
- **cms**：Web-CMS漏洞
- **app**：应用漏洞
- **emg**：应急漏洞
description.en:
The type of vulnerabilities to export. Valid values:

- **cve**: Linux software vulnerability
- **sys**: Windows system vulnerability
- **cms**: Web-CMS vulnerability
- **app**: application vulnerability
- **emg**: emergency vulnerability

description.zh: 要查询漏洞的服务器的UUID，多个UUID使用半角逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The UUIDs of the servers to query for vulnerabilities. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,).

description.zh:
要查询漏洞的VPC实例ID。多个ID使用半角逗号（,）分隔。
> 您可以调用[DescribeVpcList](~~DescribeVpcList~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The instance IDs of the VPC-connected instances to query for vulnerabilities. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).
> Invoke the [DescribeVpcList](~~DescribeVpcList~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh: 漏洞组件信息列表
description.en: The list of vulnerability component information.

description.zh: 组件名称
description.en: The name of the component.

description.zh: 组件版本
description.en: The version of the component.

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于导出漏洞列表。可用于导出Linux软件漏洞、Windows系统漏洞、Web-CMS漏洞、应用漏洞以及应急漏洞的漏洞列表。

本接口与DescribeVulExportInfo接口配合使用。使用本接口建立漏洞导出任务之后，可调用DescribeVulExportInfo接口录入漏洞导出任务的ID，查看漏洞导出任务的进度。

### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Exports a vulnerability list. You can export vulnerability lists for Linux software vulnerabilities, Windows system vulnerabilities, Web-CMS vulnerabilities, application vulnerabilities, and emergency vulnerabilities.

This operation is used together with the DescribeVulExportInfo operation. After you call this operation to create a vulnerability export task, call the [DescribeVulExportInfo](~~DescribeVulExportInfo~~) operation with the export task ID to check the progress of the export task.

### QPS limit
The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 10 calls per second. If the number of calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. This may affect your business. Manage your calls appropriately.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas export-vul --lang zh --type app --uuids 1587bedb-fdb4-48c4-9330-0000 --alias-name RHSA-2019:3197-Important:_sudo_security_update --necessity asap --dealed n --group-id 8834224 --search-tags Restart_required --attach-types sca --vpc-instance-ids ins-1330000,ins-54140000 --cve-id CVE-2022-44702 --path /etc/test --container-name xxljob-7b87597b99-mcskr --image-name container-000:0000 --create-ts-start 1696128144000 --create-ts-end 1696186800000 --rasp-defend 0 --vul-entity-list EntityVersion=1.0.0 EntityName=Ollama --resource-directory-account-id 1 --asset-type ECS --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
